how: Runs f68 and f69 on the oracle, Blocks Probe, a new block each time, unsaved, left by Exit Without Saving (the page read 0 blocks after each). Named presses with an on-top check; real keys Enter and letters for the Description (no copy, cut or paste).

iconThickness.control: The more button (fourth in the S M L row) turns into a field reading the current value in px with Decrement and Increment buttons beside it (field 206,339,28,22; buttons 32 by 44 at 240 and 272, panel-relative). There is no range here, unlike Icon Size.

limits.note: At 10 Increment keeps 10, at 1 Decrement keeps 1; both buttons stay enabled at full opacity at the limits.

startsAt.note: more keeps the line the preset drew

iconThickness.draws: Both lines of the plus are the value thick, centred in the 14px icon: at 1px the horizontal line is 0,6.5,14,1; at 10px 0,2,14,10.
